name: Data Browser Pressing (Web)

endpoints.description: List/filter data record Pressing (gabungan sync mobile & input web) dengan pagination
Ekspor data Pressing terfilter ke CSV/Excel

success_schema.note: Response body adalah file stream/binary, bukan JSON

error_codes.condition: dataset terlalu besar atau error saat proses ekspor

business_logic: 1. Validate query params (date_from/date_to) -> if date_from > date_to: return 422 INVALID_DATE_RANGE, filter tidak diterapkan
2. Build query: pressing-record WHERE business_unit_id matches (via station->business_unit_id, if provided) AND date BETWEEN date_from/date_to (if provided)

4. filled_slot_count per record dihitung via withCount() dengan constraint OR across 6 kolom bacaan (digester_temp_c, digester_level_percent, press_motor_current_amps, cone_hydraulic_pressure_bar, dilution_water_temp_c, downtime_reason) NOT NULL -- sejak revisi 2026-08-24 (Pressing Detail tidak lagi di-pre-generate 24 baris sekaligus), metrik ini bisa jadi SAMA DENGAN total baris pada record (jika semua baris yang ditambahkan sudah terisi) atau lebih kecil (jika ada baris ditambahkan tapi belum diisi bacaan apapun) -- tetap dihitung dari kolom bacaan terisi, bukan sekadar COUNT(*) baris
6. On export: re-run query filter yang sama tanpa pagination, generate file CSV/Excel -> if dataset terlalu besar/error: return 422 EXPORT_FAILED
7. Return file stream untuk didownload user

data_operations.description: SELECT records dengan filter tanggal/business_unit, dipaginasi
SELECT records dengan filter yang sama, unpaginated, untuk keperluan ekspor
COUNT baris pressing-detail (dengan minimal 1 kolom bacaan non-null) per record untuk kolom filled_slot_count

edge_case_handling.handling: Return 200 dengan data: [], FE tampilkan empty state dengan opsi reset filter
Navigasi client-side ke Detail Pressing (Web), bukan panggilan API tambahan

business_rules_applied: Data mencakup hasil sync mobile & input web
Daftar termuat <=2 detik untuk dataset normal
filled_slot_count dihitung dari baris yang punya minimal satu kolom bacaan terisi (bisa sama dengan atau lebih kecil dari total baris pada record, sejak baris tidak lagi selalu berjumlah 24)

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 INVALID_DATE_RANGE when date_from is greater than date_to
unit_test_cases.given: request query params date_from='2026-08-20', date_to='2026-08-10' passed to PressingRecordService.list()
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException / return HTTP 422 with error_code INVALID_DATE_RANGE; filter is not applied to the query

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 EXPORT_FAILED when export dataset is too large or an error occurs during file generation
unit_test_cases.given: PressingRecordService.export() query returns a dataset exceeding the export size limit, or the CSV/Excel file writer throws an error
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ExportFailedException / return HTTP 422 with error_code EXPORT_FAILED

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: valid date_from <= date_to, valid business_unit_id, page/per_page provided; pressingRecordRepo.findFiltered() returns paginated records with filled_slot_count computed
unit_test_cases.expect: return { data: [...pressing-record rows], meta: { page, per_page, total, total_pages } } with HTTP 200

unit_test_cases.description: computes filled_slot_count as count of detail rows with at least one non-null reading column, not simply the total row count on the record
unit_test_cases.given: a record has 3 pressing_detail rows (added by the user via Tambah Baris), 2 of which have at least one non-null value among the 6 reading columns and 1 fully null (added but not yet filled)

screen_dependencies.reason: Aksi Tambah Data membuka form input web

implementation_notes: Ekspor sebaiknya dijalankan sebagai proses async/background job untuk dataset besar; NFR <=2 detik hanya berlaku untuk list, tidak eksplisit untuk export
Data source gabungan: record hasil sync manual dari mobile + record input langsung dari web (screen-058)

filled_slot_count dihitung via withCount('pressingDetails', fn(q) => q->where(fn(q2) => q2->whereNotNull('digester_temp_c')->orWhereNotNull('digester_level_percent')->orWhereNotNull('press_motor_current_amps')->orWhereNotNull('cone_hydraulic_pressure_bar')->orWhereNotNull('dilution_water_temp_c')->orWhereNotNull('downtime_reason'))) -- mirrors ThreshingRecordService's filled_slot_count pattern (screen-049) exactly, adapted for Pressing's own 6 reading columns; REVISED 2026-08-24: Pressing Detail rows are now also a variable, dynamically-added row count (no longer 'always 24') -- this withCount() logic itself is UNCHANGED, it already correctly counted only filled rows regardless of total row count
